data.name: HOTELITO PATIO AZUL
data.address: P.º de Las Conchas Chinas 127, Conchas Chinas, 48399 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
On a hillside overlooking the Pacific Ocean, this refined adults-only hotel is 2 km from Los Muertos Beach and 3 km from the Puerto Vallarta Pier. Licenciado Gustavo Diaz Ordaz International Airport is 12 km away.
Chic, colorful rooms are individually decorated. All offer flat-screens and sitting areas. Upgraded rooms add balconies and/or ocean views. Room service is available.
An open-air restaurant features ocean views. Other amenities include a gym and an outdoor pool, as well as a hot tub and a spa. Breakfast and Wi-Fi are available.
